name: Zimiray
source:
Zimiray (full name is Zimiray Mevela) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
An adult flame-eyed dark-pink om'verai with crescent-like forehead horns, with a face separated into 2 parts and relatively narrow light-colored belly plates.
"Any other time my brother would have cracked an ironical joke..." - Gherstie Mevela.
"Well, his stomach could digest even 2 chio'tau old fathdog's leg" - Gherstie Mevela.
"My brother'd better stay away from kitchen untensils" - Gherstie Mevela.
Zimiray is a reliable older brother with first aid skills, described by doctors as 'professional' ones.
